hook.text: Your tests run 80 out of 100 lines of code. The other 20 lines have never been executed. What's hiding there?

buildup.text: Statement coverage measures the percentage of code statements that tests actually execute.

discovery.text: Unreached statements may contain dead code, error handlers, or edge case logic that's never been validated.

twist.text: 100% statement coverage doesn't mean all logic is tested. A line can execute without its conditions being fully checked.

climax.text: Statement coverage is the weakest structural metric but the easiest to measure and a useful starting point.

punchline.text: If a line never runs, you've never tested it. Start there.

quiz.question: What does statement coverage measure?
options: Percentage of code statements executed by tests
